blocks.text: Winter arrived seemingly overnight in South Korea on Wednesday, with morning temperatures plunging below freezing in many inland regions. According to the Korea Meteorological Administration, a cold air mass moving south overnight sent temperatures down to minus 3.6 degrees Celsius in Daegwallyeong, Gangwon Province, and minus 2.5 C in Paju, Gyeonggi Province. In Seoul, the morning low fell to 4.3 C, marking the lowest temperature so far this fall. Frost and ice were also observed in parts of the central inland regions, including Daejeon and Chuncheon.
